## The problem

What are you trying to do that voicequal does not do well today?

## Proposed change

Describe the feature. If it is a new metric, say what signal it captures
that the existing four do not.

## How would we know it works?

For anything that touches the tier decision, describe how it would show
up on the benchmark (see `benchmarks/README.md`). See `ROADMAP.md` for
what is already planned.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, or existing tools that do this.
